content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the properties of digestive enzymes
Explain how enzyme structure relates to function
Describe factors affecting enzyme activity in digestion
Understand enzyme specificity in digestive processes

are biological catalysts that speed up the breakdown of food molecules. They are specific to their substrates and work under particular conditions. Understanding enzyme properties helps explain how digestion works and why different enzymes function in different parts of the gut.
